title: Convergence of a minimizing movement scheme for contact-angle mean curvature flow in a smooth bounded domain
summary: This paper studies a Chambolle-type minimizing movement scheme for mean curvature flow with prescribed contact angle in a smooth bounded domain. The scheme is based on the capillary functional and the geodesic signed distance relative to the container, and yields a time-discrete level-set approximation.
